newsitem.title: DOMINICAN REPUBLIC: Cuban foreign minister to visit Dominican Republic.
newsitem.headline: Cuban foreign minister to visit Dominican Republic.

text.p: Cuban Foreign Minister Roberto Robaina began an official visit to the Dominican Republic on Tuesday, and immediately asked its support against a tougher U.S. economic embargo against Cuba.
"We have come to ask for the solidarity of the Dominican government and its people in the face of the threats from the United States to stiffen the embargo against Cuba," he said.

Robaina was greeted at the airport by Dominican Foreign Minister Eduardo Latorre. He was scheduled to meet later in the day with Dominican President Leonel Fernandez and to leave the country Tuesday night.
The Cuban official, who has been visiting Latin American nations, said those governments had been receptive to his request for support.
"We come seeking solidarity, although we do not expect an immediate answer," he said.
Cuba and the Dominican Republic do not maintain formal diplomatic relations, but they have a trading relationship and there is scheduled air travel between them.
